narration.text: City inspections booked in sequence on two cities' portals, on the first day each can happen. This is a chore for the project coordinator of a general contractor building townhomes in one city and a store addition and canopy in the next. Athena works it across 4 portals: Permitway, Civicdesk, Sitegrid and Crew calendar. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 2,400 dollars of the 2,400 dollars there was to find. All 6 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: Framing before the rough trades are all approved. Insulation that is not installed. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 36 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
